title: Pilot source-aware task fingerprints with frozen retrieval evaluation
description: Continue the approved TASK-277 retrieval lane from TASK-256 without making fingerprints canonical truth. Build a source-aware production pilot that derives compact fingerprints from released task, submission, review, decision, and primary-source evidence, links every projection back to canonical sources, and evaluates task recall, source recall, abstention, and token reduction on a frozen holdout.
acceptance_criteria: Fingerprints are generated only from canonical released-task, submission, review, decision, and primary-source references and retain backlinks to each source.
A frozen holdout measures expected-task recall, expected-primary-source recall, abstention behavior, and context-byte reduction separately.
The pilot cannot silently substitute a fingerprint for raw evidence and clearly marks missing or contradictory source state.
Promotion thresholds and failure criteria are declared before evaluation; results do not enable default production routing automatically.
Focused deterministic tests pass and the artifact compares results directly with TASK-256 baseline evidence.
